tools.name: dialog_ask_store_assistant
tools.description: Ask miin-cosmetics.de's shopping assistant, an expert on its catalog, buying guides and policies, an open question and get a written answer in the shopper's language plus up to 5 recommended products (title, url, price, currency, availability). Use it when the shopper needs advice rather than a lookup: which product fits a use case or budget, how two products compare, what to pair with an item, or a shipping or returns question the policies leave open (triggers: "which one should I", "what do you recommend", "is X better than Y", "does it work with"). To list, search or open pages use search_catalog or get_product. Follow-up questions keep the conversation context; one question per call. Read-only: never changes the page or the cart.

question.description: The question, in the shopper's language, with the context the assistant needs (use case, budget, constraints).
